name: P-015 R-4 identity settings live review and revision diff
summary: A real isolated Tauri shell (bridge PID 2143818, dev port 33700, display :90) passed origin health and loaded /settings/identities. Selecting the built-in su.mode-ideate identity and pointer-clicking Review switch produced the Current agent review state, URL identityTab=agent, a revision diff with applied and selected fields, and a non-disabled Apply identity control. The delivery controls remained disabled as policy-derived indicators. The installed papercusp-engineer path separately returned HTTP 409 because its publisher attestation is missing; that refusal was preserved as residue and was not bypassed.

assertions.evidence: verify-tauri-headless reported apiHealth=200 and rootHtml=200; bridge provenance owner was agent:su-5fe0f2de-a2a8-4019-99cb-85117be748c0:run:1789834474067892588-2047131-9807, PID 2143818, port 33700.
tauri-agent-tools check passed location.pathname === /settings/identities and the identity panel rendered.

After scrolling the Review switch control into the viewport, tauri-agent-tools click --pid 2143818 .pc-identities__detail .pc-identities__actions button activated the rendered control; the page URL gained identityTab=agent and the Switch review fieldset rendered.

The rendered Revision diff contained inputs[2].bytes and inputs[2].contentHash applied/selected rows; the Apply identity button was present and enabled for the reviewed change. Delivery radio controls were disabled, confirming delivery is derived from slot policy.

Selecting installed papercusp-engineer produced POST /api/agent-mcp/identity-management status 409. Direct source inspection identified attestation-missing (publisher attestation absent); the UI did not apply the untrusted identity. The pre-fix response exposed an empty error string and is tracked by EI-23708230039069066.

notProven: sync invalidation after a durable apply
